[भेषजमेव स्वार्थे अण्] A medicine, drug. 
-जः The bird called लावक or quail.

[भिषजः कर्म, भेषज-स्वार्थे वा ष्यञ्] 
__1 Administering medicines, medical treatment. 
__2 A medicament, [Page1212-1] medicine, drug; सर्वस्नेहधान्यक्षारलवणभैषज्य … … … [[Kau.
A patronymic of Rukmiṇī, daughter of Bhīṣmaka of Vidarbha.
